notes.title: Joe Higashi roars onto the FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves roster this fall!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="Vg77fN1dPKw;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][b]Beloved series staple Joe Higashi is back in town!
Fresh, fearless offense and an all-new legend await![/b][/h3][p align="start"]Muay Thai champion Joe Higashi debuted alongside fellow heroes Terry and Andy Bogard in the series’ first entry, FATAL FURY (1991), solidifying their status as faces of the franchise for generations. Now, 26 years after his last roster appearance (1999’s FATAL FURY: WILD AMBITION), Joe makes his triumphant return as a playable character! Buckle up as the Summoner of Storms sweeps through South Town once more in FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves![/p][p][/p][h3][b]JOE HIGASHI[/b][/h3][p][b]Voice Actors: Kevin Andrew Rivera (EN), Kozo Mito (JA)[/b][/p][p align="start"]Famed Muay Thai fighter with stiff kicks that can shatter steel. No other kickboxer can lay a finger, elbow, or knee on Joe Higashi, so the champ winds up tackling a different beast: the silver screen! His biopic documentary, [i]The Legend of Joe[/i] (directed by none other than Cheng Sinzan), is already shooting around South Town; Joe even envisions a bit part for star pupil Preecha, whose recent tournament triumphs have done her master proud.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050745/b3e4b4fbb09f1c9daca46045909577d35f08f8e2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050745/38acd33c288b5ed66137fd1b4170912a06727364.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]New stories in Arcade Mode and EOST (Episodes of South Town)![/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]Arcade Mode:[/b] Joe and legacy character Cheng Sinzan set out to film a major motion picture, [i]The Legend of Joe[/i], based on the Muay Thai master’s eventful life.[/p][p align="start"][b]EOST:[/b] Joe’s single-player RPG adventure sees him romp through the city while reminiscing about how he met star pupil Preecha.[/p][p align="start"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050745/4eafab3c8686c5aa1ca200b325129d536aaaf515.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]CotW Special Edition includes Season Pass 1 from the get-go!
Play as Joe Higashi, Street Fighter’s Ken and Chun-Li, and the rest of the Season 1 roster upon release![/b][/h3][p align="start"]* FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves will only be available in this Special Edition format.
* There are no plans at this time to sell the base game and Season Pass 1 individually.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050745/769e1c7100c73b28c0b0bbdbefe52fd1f07db212.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Ken from Street Fighter brings the heat to FATAL FURY:CotW this summer!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050745/37f9a1280dcac5ee1109d0b3f0e5e9400f080be8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]KEN: Character Trailer[/b][/p][p]English VA: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/kKbFMdNeBzU"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Japanese VA: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/kBPbkPkTD2c"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b] Fatal Fury x Street Fighter: The dream crossover![/b][/p][p]Ken and Chun-Li from Capcom's renowned fighting game franchise Street Fighter are coming to FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves! Their inclusion amounts to a legendary crossover like no other, as Fatal Fury's own Terry Bogard and Mai Shiranui are already on the Street Fighter 6 roster. Ken and Chun-Li join City of the Wolves as part of Season Pass 1, with Ken arriving in Summer 2025 and Chun-Li in Winter 2025.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Ken[/b][/p][p][b]Voice Actors: Yuji Kishi (JA), David Matranga (EN)[/b][/p][p]A veteran Metro City street fighter who sets his sights on South Town, seeking closure for an incident to which he was wrongfully tied. Burning with determination and a fiery arsenal of unmatched offense, this former US National Fighting Champion eventually crosses paths with the Legendary Wolf himself—and with that, the wheels of fate are set in motion.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050745/0af122d83a7f8a432019104a88eb555cd3a55fa5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050745/de388b00479f607a1a19293817475bb625484346.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Comes with classic red gi as an alternate costume![/b][/p][p]Players can choose to fight in Ken's iconic martial arts gi (as seen in Street Fighter 6 as Outfit 2) if they so desire.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050745/5f0c79b1bcb72834d48036c73fb1f05821bcab01.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]New original stories for Ken in Arcade Mode and EOST![/b][/p][p]Arcade Mode depicts the first meeting between Ken and Terry, serving as a prologue to their upcoming battles. In single-player RPG mode "EOST," follow Ken as he unravels the plot of a shadowy figure who has begun to warp the people of South Town.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050745/3328586ab43bed2c66139a88c445ad0ce6c2eb9b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]CotW Special Edition includes Street Fighter’s Ken and Chun-Li, plus the other DLC characters in Season Pass 1! Available now![/b][/p][p]* FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves will only be available in this Special Edition format.[/p][p]* There are no plans at this time to sell the base game and Season Pass 1 individually.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050745/769e1c7100c73b28c0b0bbdbefe52fd1f07db212.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves (PC) Review
notes.notes:
Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves heralds the return of the long-dormant series after 26 years — and thankfully does so in a game that can stand toe-to-toe with its contemporaries. For the uninitiated, the Fatal Fury series is one of SNK’s oldest franchises. It eventually gave way to titles like The King of Fighters, with the latter initially appearing as part of an early Fatal Fury game.

Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves continues the trend of combining elements from SNK’s storied fighting game history, while also promising to include upcoming Capcom characters in its initial season pass roster, such as Ken Masters and Chun-Li.

On a more topical note, Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves will launch with a base roster of 17 characters, including King of Fighters headliners such as Mai Shiranui and Terry Bogard (who recently appeared as guest characters in Street Fighter 6). Stranger inclusions are also expected, with the likes of Cristiano Ronaldo and Salvatore Ganacci reportedly... Read more
